excerpt.zh: 方舟舰释放出纳米机群，溶解并占据这个世界。岩石、土壤和大气被分解，并重组为纳米机器。
excerpt.en: The Arkship releases its nanite swarms to dissolve and claim this world. Rock, soil, and atmosphere are broken down and reassembled into nanites.

texts.zh: 方舟舰释放出纳米机群，溶解并占据这个世界。岩石、土壤和大气被分解，并重组为纳米机器。
texts.en: The Arkship releases its nanite swarms to dissolve and claim this world. Rock, soil, and atmosphere are broken down and reassembled into nanites.

sections.zh: 方舟舰必须在180天内返回[Target.GetName]的轨道，否则侵蚀行动将被放弃。
sections.en: An Arkship must return to orbit of [Target.GetName] within 180 days or the consumption will be abandoned.
